template: multiply(group_zscore(subtract(winsorize(ts_backfill({exp_usa}, 21), std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill({exp_chn}, 21), std=4)), industry), subtract(1.3, multiply(0.6, rank(days_from_last_change(subtract(winsorize(ts_backfill({exp_usa}, 21), std=4), winsorize(ts_backfill({exp_chn}, 21), std=4)))))))
